Install omarchy-chromium-bin on Omarchy

Chromium is the open-source web browser project developed and used by Google as the base for Chrome, and also underlying Edge, Opera, Brave, and others. It aims to be a fast, safe, and stable way to browse the web, and its source and design documents are fully public. This package delivers a prebuilt Chromium binary with Omarchy's patches applied, so you get a working browser without compiling it yourself.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-chromium-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 148.0.7778.96-22:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-chromium-bin

Open and use omarchy-chromium-bin

omarchy-chromium-bin is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omarchy-chromium-bin | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-chromium-bin on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-chromium-bin. The download is 154.2 MB and it takes 385.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-chromium-bin free?

Free and open source (BSD-licensed source; site content under CC-BY 2.5). The package is licensed BSD-3-Clause.

How do I uninstall omarchy-chromium-bin?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-chromium-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-chromium-bin depend on?

The package declares 16 dependencies: gtk3, nss, alsa-lib, xdg-utils, libxss, libcups, libgcrypt, ttf-liberation, systemd, dbus, libpulse, pciutils and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-chromium-bin a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omarchy-chromium-bin.

Is omarchy-chromium-bin in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-chromium-bin (version 148.0.7778.96-22) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://www.chromium.org/Home.
